computation: jq over registered analysis.json, session result.json+host-events.jsonl, and all72 host-before/after snapshots; medians of three trials; no new benchmark

combined_cpu_parity.distinction: Planned application bytes agree; actual encrypted canonical-envelope bytes vary with independently provisioned identifiers and metadata and must be reported as measured.

host_observations.limitation: Snapshots at session boundaries only; zero observed compiler count does not prove an otherwise idle or exclusive host.

timing_limits: Sender setup includes public fixture generation, codec preparation, handshake and Status; it is not pure encoder preparation.
Paid artifact setup operations are a subset of operation totals, not an additional disjoint time bucket.
Readback counters time byte comparison/file reads per object; fixture regeneration around verification remains in lifecycle time.
Sender setup plus operations equals recorded sender session CPU/wall. Receiver setup plus processing equals recorded receiver totals; excludes framed receive and idle waiting.
Host orchestrator CPU contains host receiver CPU in stageone and relay CPU in stagetwo. Worker CPU contains guest execution. Do not sum these nested domains.
Readback, verification and boot are outside sender session wall and included in separately reported lifecycle; relay/socket exchange is not send-only timing.
Three trials per cell are descriptive. Small envelope-byte differences are not evidence of a codec change; no energy/WAN/production claim.

policy_skip_interpretation.explanation: Only the 12 unrelated operations replace a full evaluated SchemaZstdV1 candidate; other 36 skips replace an already proven pruning decision.

repeat_mode_interpretation: Combined repeat rows report Raw as the publication mode while exact_repeat_probe=true; this does not mean full raw payload transmission. Mode is checked alongside actual counters and selection details.
